set.body:
Outcome

Replace the legacy ScalaFIM VolumeDomain boundary only through an explicit, tested migration between first-axis-fastest ScalaFIM ordinals and the versioned image4s-locus grid layout. Prevent silent reinterpretation of regions, selections, assignments, searchlight centers, persisted maps, and fixtures.

Prerequisites

- Complete local image4s-locus admission gate bd-01KZ6BDR9A7EWGEP81HY2CJNX5.
- Complete scoped-registry task bd-01KZ6BCEXQYZNN61TJ7AVRKKE8.
- This task belongs to existing image-unification epic bd-01KYNR99SWCFEW94T4JGD9QPBS and is deliberately separate from locus-data deletion.

Decision gate

Record an ADR choosing between:
A. one canonical image4s-locus layout with explicit conversion of all legacy ordinal artifacts; or
C. permanent support for both LastAxisFastestV1 and a generally justified FirstAxisFastestV1 layout.

Regardless of the long-term choice, use B as the transition mechanism: a checked coordinate-derived Bijection[LegacyScalaFimVoxel,CanonicalImage4sVoxel]. Do not infer layout from physical storage.

Work

- Inventory every source of legacy ordinal-bearing data: VolumeDomain, Indexing, NeuroVol, regions, selections, parcellations/assignments, searchlight centers, persistence records, fixtures, archives, and I/O adapters.
- Establish a migration court on asymmetric 2 x 3 x 5 shapes with explicit coordinate-to-ordinal tables for both layouts.
- Derive voxel-domain persistent identity from the complete grid key plus versioned layout.
- Separate acquisition, run, atlas, and semantic metadata from finite voxel-domain identity.
- Apply the bijection at every legacy/canonical boundary and version or reject persisted artifacts that lack enough layout evidence.
- Retire VolumeIdentityBasis.Semantic and the local VolumeDomain only after every consumer and persistence path is accounted for.

Acceptance

- No bare ordinal vector crosses between legacy and canonical layouts.
- Coordinate/ordinal round trips, forward/inverse bijection laws, region/selection transport, assignment fibers, center order, and persisted-record conversion pass on JVM and Scala.js.
- Same shape with different layout has distinct persistent identity.
- Semantic acquisitions share or align voxel domains through explicit evidence, not a reused string DomainId.
- Unknown-layout persisted data is rejected or migrated by an explicit caller policy.
- Full image, dataset, atlas, surface/MVPA integration, serialization, and repository aggregate gates pass.
- The evidence records the chosen permanent layout policy and every converted artifact family.

Non-goals

Do not hide legacy ordering behind a type alias, infer it from array storage, create spatial4s-locus, or combine this migration with unrelated image representation work.
set.title: Migrate VolumeDomain voxel order and persistent identity through checked image4s-locus alignment
